name: qjs_get_typed_array_buffer_composition
prototype: JSValue qjs_get_typed_array_buffer(JSContext *ctx, JSValue value, size_t *poffset, size_t *plength, size_t *pelement_size)

ownership.argument: Composed from the measured typed-array layout: payload pointer at object+0x24, element count at object+0x28, and the element size derived from the class id at object+6 - 23 for Uint8Array (1 byte) and 25 for Uint16Array (2 bytes), the ids being consecutive across the typed-array run. The byte offset output is NOT measured on this build: only the payload and the element count were confirmed, so poffset must be treated as unusable until an offset field is observed.

provenance.source: Measured on the live runtime: Uint8Array(512) object at 0x3C3146D0 has class 23, payload 0x3C3A1B28 at +0x24 and element count 512 at +0x28; Uint16Array(16) object at 0x3C314610 has class 25, payload 0x3C313590 at +0x24 and count 16 at +0x28.
